newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.African court denies bail to Tutu's son.
newsitem.headline: S.African court denies bail to Tutu's son.

text.p: South African Nobel peace laureate Desmond Tutu's son Trevor was denied bail on Tuesday pending his appeal against a jail term for making a false bomb threat.
Police arrested Trevor Tutu last week -- four years after he skipped bail to avoid a 3-1/2 year jail term for making a false bomb threat at the airport in the Indian Ocean port of East London.
Magistrate Eugene Moss ruled that Tutu, 41, would stay in custody pending an appeal -- his fifth -- against the sentence.
Giving Tutu bail would be make a mockery of the criminal justice and bail systems, Moss said.
Tutu was caught last Friday in Johannesburg, where he had been living with a friend.
The arrest came soon after a local newspaper reported finding Tutu after just a few days of searching and criticised police for failing to do the same for four years.
